subtitle.en: Advanced Mathematics for the EST II subject test — algebra, functions, geometry, trigonometry, and statistics beyond EST I.

note.en: Register & access official EST II practice materials

downloadsInfo.introText: Take the EST II Math material offline. The PDF prints from your browser; the Word packet contains editable OMML equations for classroom use.
downloadsInfo.pdfCardDescription: All eight advanced chapters plus every worked solution — sequences, trig, geometry, solids, and statistics.
downloadsInfo.docxCardDescription: Editable .docx with real Word equations (OMML) — all EST II topics ready for customisation and printing.
downloadsInfo.worksheetLibraryText: 8 original ClipSAT worksheets with full answer keys, organized by unit — free to download and print.

testGenerator.introText: Build a randomised EST II Math mini-test from the question bank, or generate a complete full-length paper formatted to the official EST II Mathematics exam structure.
testGenerator.examDescription: Generates a complete 44-question EST II Mathematics paper — Section I (no calculator) and Section II (calculator) — formatted like an official timed exam paper.
